_comment: Cab/auto pickup points outside stations, used by Station Navigator. Only names that are widely-known public pickup spots are listed. lat/lng are null until verified on the ground - never guessed - and the app then opens the map by place name. `verified` is false for every entry added from general knowledge; the app labels such points accordingly. Add a station by adding a code key; stations without an entry fall back to a generic 'Main entrance' pickup.

points.name: Clock Tower
points.hint: Cab/auto stand near the station's clock tower

points.name: Main Gate
points.hint: Cabs wait outside the main entrance gate

points.name: Parcel Office
points.hint: Pickup near the parcel office side exit
